arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي إنْ كانَ قَلَّ زادِي فِي الْمَسِيرِ إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: ilaaheee in kaana qal-la zaadee fil-maseeri ilay-ka
english_text: My God, though my stores for travelling to You are few,
my confidence in You has given me a good opinion.

arabic_text: وَإنْ كانَ جُرْمِي قَدْ أَخافَنِي مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa in kaana jur-mee qad akhaafanee min u'qoobatik
english_text: Though my sin has made me fear Your punishment,

arabic_text: فَإنَّ رَجائِي قَدْ أَشْعَرَنِي بِالأَمْنِ مِنْ نِقْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: fa in-na rajaaa-ee qad ash-a'ranee bil-am-ni min-naqimatika
english_text: my hope has let me feel secure from Your vengeance.

arabic_text: وَإنْ كانَ ذَنْبِي قَدْ عَرَّضَنِي لِعِقابِكَ،
transliteration: wa in kaana d'ambee qad a'r-raz''anee lii'qaabika
english_text: Though my misdeed has exposed me to Your penalty,
my excellent trust has apprised me of Your reward.

arabic_text: وَإنْ أَنامَتْنِي الْغَفْلَةُ عَنِ الاسْتِعْدادِ لِلِقائِكَ،
english_text: Though heedlessness has put to sleep my readiness to meet You,
knowledge has awakened me to Your generosity and boons.

arabic_text: وَإنْ أَوْحَشَ ما بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ فَرْطُ الْعِصْيانِ وَالطُّغْيانِ،
transliteration: wa in aw-h'asha maa bay-nee wa bay-naka far-t'ul-i's'-yaani wat'-t'ugh-yaani
english_text: Though excessive disobedience and rebellion have estranged me from You,
the glad tidings of forgiveness and good pleasure have made me feel intimate with You.

transliteration: as-aluka bisubuh'aati waj-hika wa bi anwari qud-sik
english_text: I ask You by the splendours of Your face and the lights of Your holiness,

arabic_text: وَأَبْتَهِلُ إلَيْكَ بِعَواطِفِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَلَطائِفِ بِرِّكَ،
transliteration: wa ab-tahilu ilay-ka bia'waat'ifi rah'-matika wa lat'aaa-ifi bir-rika
english_text: and I implore You by the tenderness of Your mercy and the gentleness of Your goodness,

arabic_text: أَنْ تُحَقِّقَ ظَنّـِي بِما أُؤَمِّلُهُ مِنْ جَزِيلِ إِكْرامِكَ،
transliteration: an tuh'aq-qiqa z'an-nee bimaaa oo-am-miluhoo min jazeeli ik-raamika
english_text: to verify my opinion in expecting Your great generosity
and Your beautiful favour,
through nearness to You,
proximity with You,
and enjoyment of gazing upon You!

arabic_text: وَها أَنا مُتَعَرِّضٌ لِنَفَحاتِ رَوْحِكَ وَعَطْفِكَ،
transliteration: wa haaa ana mutaa'r-riz''ul-linafah'aati raw-h'ika wa a't'-fika
english_text: Here am I, addressing myself to the breezes of Your freshness and tenderness,

transliteration: wa muntajiu'n ghay-tha joodika wa lut'-fika
english_text: having recourse to the rain of Your generosity and gentleness,
fleeing from Your displeasure to Your good pleasure
and from You to You,
hoping for the best of what is with You,
relying upon Your gifts,
utterly poor toward Your guarding!

arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي ما بَدَأْتَ بِهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ فَتَمِّمْهُ،
transliteration: ilaahee maa badaa-ta bihee min faz''-lika fatam-mim-hoo
english_text: My God, Your bounty which You have begun - complete it!

arabic_text: وَما وَهَبْتَ لِي مِنْ كَرَمِكَ فَلا تَسْلُبْهُ،
transliteration: wa maa wahab-ta lee min karamika falaa tas-lub-h
english_text: Your generosity which You have given me - strip it not away!

arabic_text: وَما سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَيَّ بِحِلْمِكَ فَلا تَهْتِكْهُ،
transliteration: wa maa satar-tahoo a'lay-ya bih'il-mika fala tah-tik-h
english_text: Your cover over me through Your clemency - tear it not away!

arabic_text: وَما عَلِمْتَهُ مِنْ قَبِيحِ فِعْلِي فَاغْفِرْهُ.
transliteration: wa maa a'lim-tahoo min qabeehee fia'-lee fagh-fir-h
english_text: My ugly acts which You have come to know - forgive them!
My God, I seek intercession from You with You,
and I seek sanctuary in You from You!
